snippet.title: Hozy - Your Next Cozy Game | Announcement Trailer | tinyBuild Connect 2025
snippet.description:
Join the Playtest Now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3326230/Hozy/ 

Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In Hozy, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. Enjoy satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls as you interact with tools, items, and furniture to bring forgotten spaces back to life.

Follow us on X: https://twitter.com/HozyGame
